A body ending in a comment or a row break keeps the closing delimiter on the
next line, with no blank line between.

$$
x = y % trailing
$$

$$
b\\
$$

\begin{align}
x = y % trailing
\end{align}

A structured delimiter body with an authored final newline must not add a blank
line before the display-math closer.

$$
\left(
\begin{matrix}
a & b \\
c & d
\end{matrix}
\right)
$$
